results.content: Nearly 1.9 million people are affected, with many families trapped or living in makeshift shelters as flooding and landslides continue.The Jamaica Red Cross, supported by the IFRC, is providing emergency shelter, food, clean water, and cash assistance. Following the [ACM guidelines](https://www.acm.org/publications/proceedings-template) a paper submitted to SIGMOD 2026 cannot be under review for any other publishing forum or presentation venue, including conferences, workshops, and journals, during the time it is being considered for SIGMOD. Every research track paper submitted to SIGMOD 2026 will undergo a double-anonymous reviewing process, following the three principles put forward in ([Snodgrass 2007](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.00177)): authors should not be required to go to great lengths to anonymize their submissions; comprehensiveness of the review trumps anonymizing efficacy.
